collections.name: Tents
collections.descriptionHtml: Hosting an outdoor event and need tent rentals in Winnipeg? We’ve got you covered! Our high-quality tent rentals provide the perfect solution for weddings, corporate events, birthday parties, festivals, and more. Designed to protect your guests from unpredictable weather while adding a touch of elegance to your event, our tents come in a variety of sizes and styles to suit any occasion.

collections.name: Tables
collections.descriptionHtml: Need space for cake, gifts, or grandma’s secret salad? We’ve got you. Tables that do the job — and look good doing it.

collections.name: Chairs
collections.descriptionHtml: Sturdy, clean, and comfy. Perfect for weddings, parties, and any event. Classic white — fits any style. Easy to move, quick to set up.

collections.name: Event Essentials
collections.descriptionHtml: Looking for those finishing touches? Our Event Essentials collection includes everything beyond tents, tables, and chairs. Browse a wide selection of linens, lawn games, lighting, heaters, décor, and other event accessories designed to make your celebration comfortable, stylish, and memorable. We're constantly adding new rental items to help you create the perfect event, all in one place.

collections.name: Linen
collections.descriptionHtml:
Renting linens in Winnipieg for your event is simple.
Just select the style.
Once you do this you can pick size, color and quantity.

collections.name: Lawn Games
collections.descriptionHtml: Keep the fun going long after the food is served. Our lawn games and event activities are perfect for guests of all ages, adding laughter, friendly competition, and unforgettable memories to any celebration. Whether you're planning a backyard party, wedding, corporate event, or family gathering, our growing collection of games has something for everyone.

collections.name: Event Lighting
collections.descriptionHtml: The right lighting can completely transform your event. Browse our selection of event lighting, stands, and decorative lighting solutions to create the perfect ambiance for weddings, parties, corporate events, and special celebrations. Whether you're looking for a soft, elegant glow or a bold statement, our lighting rentals help bring your vision to life.

products.name: 20x20 Marquee Tent
products.descriptionHtml:
Our 20 × 20 frame tent is a spacious and reliable option for weddings, parties, and other outdoor events. With 400 sq ft of covered space, it provides plenty of room for seating, dining, and activities.

Tent Info

Size: 20′ × 20′
Coverage area: 400 sq ft

Seating capacity

Up to 32 guests with round tables
Up to 40 guests with rectangular tables

Optional Add-Ons (additional cost)

• Side walls
• Event lighting
• Concrete blocks

Installation

Tent setup and takedown are included with the rental.

DELIVERY REQUIRED

THIS TENT IS NOT AVAILABLE FOR CUSTOMER PICKUP. DELIVERY AND PROFESSIONAL INSTALLATION ARE REQUIRED.

Delivery and pickup start from Medium Delivery and are charged separately.

Additional Notes

If the tent cannot be staked into the ground (for example on asphalt, concrete, or gravel), it will need to be secured with concrete blocks, which are available for an additional charge.

products.name: 48ft Strand Of Bistro Lights (24 LIGHT)
products.descriptionHtml:
These stylish lights feature a black finish and are designed for indoor and outdoor use, making them perfect for tents, wedding decor, backdrops or anywhere decorative and accent light is desired. Each strand includes a 48 foot cord with 24 LED filament Edison bulbs spaced 2 feet apart. You can connect up to 45 strands together.

•UL certified for wet location
•Volts: 125 V
•Indoor or Outdoor use
•24 Suspended sockets – 60.9 cm (24 in.) apart
•Shatter-resistant plastic bulbs
•Bulb base: E26
•Connect up to 45 sets of strings
•Actual wattage: 1W
•Bulb brightness (lumens): 60 lm

products.name: 8x8 Pop Up Tent
products.descriptionHtml: Elevate your outdoor gatherings with our sturdy and spacious 8' x 8' Pop-Up Tent in Winnipeg! Designed for rapid assembly and exceptional durability, it's the perfect solution for any event.

products.name: Cornhole Toss
products.descriptionHtml: Bring classic backyard fun to the next level with the Cornhole! Designed for hours of competitive play, this premium set features solid wood tournament-size boards and a smooth bean bag return ramp for quick retrieval. Integrated storage keeps your bags organized, while the durable rope handles make transporting your game easy and convenient. Perfect for family gatherings, tailgates, or neighborhood tournaments, Heritage Cornhole delivers a timeless game experience everyone will enjoy.

products.name: Easy Set-Up Badminton Set
products.descriptionHtml: Enjoy fast-paced backyard fun with the Penn Easy Setup Badminton! Designed for quick assembly, this set can be ready in minutes and easily folds into a compact carry caddy for effortless transport. Featuring a durable steel base and premium one-piece aluminum rackets with cushioned grips, this set is perfect for players of all skill levels. Whether at family gatherings, tailgates, or casual outdoor play, Penn Easy Setup Badminton delivers hours of active, competitive fun for ages 8 and up.

products.name: Giant Guess Who?
products.descriptionHtml: Go big with one of the world’s favorite guessing games! The Giant Guess Who? brings supersized fun to family game night, backyard gatherings, or classroom play. Players take turns asking clever yes-or-no questions to narrow down the possibilities and reveal their opponent’s mystery character. With giant boards and oversized character cards, the fun is easy to see and enjoy for players of all ages. Quick to set up and simple to play, Giant Guess Who? makes a classic game even more exciting.

products.name: Giant KerPlunk
products.descriptionHtml: Bring larger-than-life fun to your next game night or backyard party with the Giant KerPlunk! This oversized version of the classic game challenges players to carefully remove sticks while trying not to let the balls tumble down. The suspense builds with every turn as the tower empties — who will cause the cascade? Designed for indoor and outdoor play, Giant KerPlunk is quick to set up, easy to play, and guaranteed to keep family and friends entertained for hours.

products.name: Pop Up Tent 10x20
products.descriptionHtml:
Our 10 × 20 pop-up tent is a practical and versatile option for smaller outdoor events, backyard gatherings, vendor booths, food stations, and other casual setups. With 200 sq ft of covered space, it provides dependable shelter and shade without requiring a larger formal tent.

Tent Info

Size: 10′ × 20′
Coverage area: 200 sq ft

Best For

• Backyard gatherings
• Food and beverage stations
• Vendor booths
• Birthday parties
• Registration and check-in areas
• Gift or dessert tables
• Small casual events

Optional Add-Ons (additional cost)

• 6′ rectangular tables
• White folding chairs
• White padded chairs

Installation

Self-pickup and drop-off are available. Delivery is also available.

SITE REQUIREMENTS

THIS TENT MUST BE INSTALLED ON GRASS OR SOIL AND IS NOT SUITABLE FOR ASPHALT, CONCRETE, GRAVEL, OR OTHER SURFACES WHERE STAKES CANNOT BE USED.

Additional Notes

This tent is best suited for smaller setups where the main need is shade or weather coverage for a specific area. For seated dining layouts or larger events, a larger tent is recommended.

products.name: Rectangular Table 6ft
products.descriptionHtml:
Our 6 ft plastic folding tables are a practical and versatile option for weddings, parties, meetings, and other events. The durable plastic top is waterproof and stain-resistant, making these tables suitable for both indoor and outdoor use.

The tables fold in half and include built-in handles, making them easy to transport and store. Their lightweight design allows for quick setup and convenient handling.

Table Info

Length: 72″ (6 ft)
Width: 30″
Height: 29.5″
Weight: 28.6 lbs (13 kg)
Material: Plastic

Seating capacity

Up to 6 people comfortably.
Up to 8 people maximum (tight seating).

Transport

Thanks to the fold-in-half design, these tables can usually fit in a sedan, SUV, or minivan.

products.name: Rectangular Table 8ft
products.descriptionHtml:
Our 8 ft plastic tables are a sturdy and spacious option for large events such as weddings, banquets, and community gatherings. The durable plastic top is waterproof and stain-resistant, making the tables suitable for both indoor and outdoor use.

These tables are strong, reliable, and designed for commercial event use.

Table Info

Length: 96″ (8 ft)
Width: 30″
Height: 29.25″

Net weight: 40.8 lb (18.5 kg)
Recommended maximum load: 1000 lb (453 kg)

Material: Plastic

Seating capacity

Up to 8 people comfortably.
Up to 10 people maximum.

Transport

These tables do not fold. Because of their full 8 ft length, they will not fit in most cars or small SUVs.
A minivan, pickup truck, cargo van, or larger vehicle is recommended for transport.

products.descriptionHtml: For the perfect "halfway to the floor" drop on all sides of an 8 foot long rectangular banquet table

products.descriptionHtml:

These tables are made of durable plastic with sturdy legs and are suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. They are widely used for weddings and can comfortably seat up to 8 people.

Table Info

Diameter: 5′

Material: Plastic

FAQ

No. These tables do not fold.

products.name: Round Table Cloths 120"

products.name: Rubbermaid Cooler
products.descriptionHtml: Perfect for camping, road trips, or backyard BBQs. Just add ice and keep your drinks or food cold for hours.

products.name: Tetris XL Tumble
products.descriptionHtml: Tetris® XL Tumble is an exhilarating new stacking game based on the iconic Tetris game. Designed to challenge players with a dynamic, tilting tower, players strategically stack oversized Tetris blocks as the tower shifts and sways. With each move, the balance of the tower changes, so stack carefully! Play head-to-head to see who can topple the tower first or play solo to see how high you can stack it! Tetris XL Tumble brings a fresh, engaging spin to one of the world's most famous puzzle games, making it a must-have game for all ages.

products.name: White Folding Chair
products.descriptionHtml:
Our white folding chairs are a simple and elegant seating option for weddings, parties, and other events. Their foldable design makes them easy to transport, store, and set up, helping you save time during event preparation.

All chairs are commercial rental quality and are carefully inspected before each rental to ensure they are clean, reliable, and ready for use. They are sturdy, practical, and suitable for both indoor and outdoor events.
